notes.title: Welcome to Caelestia Notes
notes.body:
This notes tab lives right inside your dashboard between Media and Performance.

• Fixed height (380px) with smooth internal scrolling
• Grid and list view toggle
• Pinned and Others organization
• Google Keep compatible data schema
